title_en: 2026 Academic Year Winter Study Abroad Program (SAP): Call for Participants
summary: Enrolled students interested in the 2026 academic year Winter Study Abroad Program (SAP) should submit an application to their own department (or division) office by Thursday, 3 September 2026. The list of successful applicants is scheduled to be announced on Wednesday, 23 September 2026. Full details are in the attached announcement, program list and form templates, which were not read for this translation.
applies_to: Currently enrolled students of the university who are interested in taking part. Participation is voluntary. The notice states no further limits on program, year or nationality; any eligibility requirements may be in the attached announcement, which was not read.

dates.what: Deadline to submit the application to your department (or division) office

conditions: Applications are submitted by the applicant to their own department (or division) office, not to the International Cooperation Support Team.
The result announcement date is tentative and may change.
Eligibility requirements, program details and required documents are given in the attachments, which were not read; check them before applying.
steps: Read the attached announcement (2026학년도 동계 Study Abroad Program (SAP) 참가자 모집 공고문.pdf) and the recommended program list (2026 동계 국제처 추천 프로그램 리스트_수정.xlsx); their contents were not read for this translation.
Download the submission form templates (제출 서류 양식.zip) attached to the notice and complete the required documents.
Submit your application in person to your own department (or division) office by Thursday, 3 September 2026.
Check for the announcement of successful applicants, planned for Wednesday, 23 September 2026.
For questions, contact the International Cooperation Support Team (국제협력지원과); the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
2026 Academic Year Winter Study Abroad Program (SAP): Call for Participants

To strengthen the global competitiveness of our enrolled students, the university will run the 2026 academic year Winter Study Abroad Program (SAP). Interested students are encouraged to take part.

1. Schedule
- Application submission: by Thursday, 3 September 2026 <Applicant → own department (or division) office>

2. Announcement of successful applicants: planned for Wednesday, 23 September 2026

3. Enquiries: International Cooperation Support Team (국제협력지원과) (contact details are in the original notice)

Attachments (3) [not read for this translation]
1-1. 2026 동계 국제처 추천 프로그램 리스트_수정.xlsx (2026 Winter Office of International Affairs Recommended Program List, revised) (18 KB)
1. 2026학년도 동계 Study Abroad Program (SAP) 참가자 모집 공고문.pdf (2026 Academic Year Winter SAP Call for Participants, announcement) (120 KB)
3. 제출 서류 양식.zip (Submission document templates) (194 KB)
